title: Fixed Twin Runner and Upright Pad Blocking Sled
description: One newly authored complete empty fixed blocking-sled exterior. Two entire thick runners have long flat ground spans and genuinely upturned ends. Three full crossmembers connect the runners; two continuous broad bent leaf-like support plates rise forward from separate clamped rear roots to the backing of one tall thick chamfered contact pad. A distinct rear cross-grip and a short tied standing-platform appearance belong to the same complete chassis. The broad pad is a whole closed three-ring cushion volume, not a plane or a box face decal. This is not a shortened hanging punching-bag frame or the old timber dummy with arms removed: there is no overhead suspension or solid central tree post, and the runner-to-bent-plate-to-pad whole structure is new. Nor is it an inclined-carriage leg press without the seat: no sliding rails, carriage sleeves, pegs or weights are reused. All numeric geometry new, one prop zero scenes and four opaque PBR appearances. Empty fixed sports-equipment visual only. No impact absorption, spring behaviour, resistance, travel, training instructions, user fit, load, balance, manufacturing or safe contact-sport operation claim. Rigging animation and interaction are not made.
